lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four to five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters beginning posterior to the gills and extending toward the caudal region, with cluster diameter increasing as spatial density decreases posteriorly.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical columns of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal blob rows, forming a discernible grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with high-intensity luminance on the dorsal aspect and deep shadow on the ventral aspect.

other_distinctive_markers: The distal surface of the visible pectoral fin contains a high-density population of small-diameter high-luminance blobs, distinct from the larger, more sparse clusters on the main flank.
